title: Bohemian Switzerland Gorges
slogan: A 285 km loop out of Bohemian Switzerland Gorges
story: A proper escape from Prague with roads worth waking up for. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 98 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Bohemian Switzerland Gorges scenic road, Bohemian Switzerland Gorges high point, Bohemian Switzerland Gorges photo pull-off, while Bohemian Switzerland Gorges fuel gate and Bohemian Switzerland Gorges food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.
